name: Schedule Agent Runs
summary: Design and verify recurring agent work without hiding state, authority, or failure.
description: Plan recurring or delayed agent work using the runtime scheduler, cron, or a supervised loop. Use when a task must run later or repeatedly and needs explicit state, permissions, output, and recovery behavior.
risk_reason: It installs a recurring agent job that can act after the initiating session, so mistakes can repeat until stopped.
refuses: It does not invent authority for future writes or external messages.
It does not create an unbounded polling loop or conceal failed runs.
It does not claim a schedule works until registration and one execution are verified.

operational.latency_reason: The skill designs and verifies recurring agent work without hiding state, authority, or failure, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
